blur_control_test.interpretation: Adding blur collapses the wavelet sigma estimate of the simulated image -> noise:sigma mismatch 93%, physically inconsistent with target. Target sigma matches noise-only simulation exactly. blur:spectral_slope/wiener MATCH is below resolution for sev1 and is a known ~18% FP pathway (SKILL blur DT FP). Combined with slope_ratio 0.9745-0.9974 on all 5 pairs and exact clipped_fraction/variance_ratio match (blur would lower both), blur is ruled out.
